cleanup.list.title: Cleanup Policies
cleanup.list.intro: Rules that delete the components nobody needs
cleanup.list.whatText: A cleanup policy says which components may go. Assign it to repositories in their settings; the cleanup task then applies the policies of every repository on its schedule.
cleanup.list.filter: Filter by name, format or notes...
cleanup.list.name: Name
cleanup.form.intro: {policies} delete the components nobody needs and give their space back. The {criteria} below decide which components go.
cleanup.form.name: Name
cleanup.form.nameHint: A unique name, for example delete-old-releases
cleanup.form.formatHint: Repositories of this format can use the policy
cleanup.form.criteriaText: A component is deleted when it matches every criterion you turn on. Turn on at least one.
cleanup.form.ageText: Published more than this many days ago (1 to 9999)
cleanup.form.usageText: Not downloaded for this many days (1 to 9999)
cleanup.form.releaseText: Delete only components of this release type
cleanup.form.regexText: Delete components with at least one asset whose name matches this regular expression
cleanup.problems.name: Use a unique name for the cleanup policy
cleanup.problems.nameRule: Name must contain only letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, and periods
cleanup.problems.notes: Description must be 4000 characters or less
cleanup.problems.criteria: Turn on at least one criterion
cleanup.problems.days: Must be a whole number between 1 and 24855
cleanup.problems.regexInvalid: Invalid regular expression pattern. Use regex syntax (e.g., ".*\.jar" instead of "*.jar")
cleanup.delete.title: Delete Cleanup Policy?
cleanup.delete.text: Repositories that use this policy will no longer be cleaned up by it. This cannot be undone.
cleanup.preview.title: Preview Cleanup Results
cleanup.preview.text: See which components the policy would delete today, or download them as a spreadsheet of namespaces, names, versions and paths.
cleanup.preview.needRepository: Choose a repository and turn on at least one criterion
cleanup.preview.noRepositories: There is no repository of this format.
cleanup.preview.name: Name
cleanup.preview.none: No components match the selected criteria
cleanup.summary.title: What this policy would delete
cleanup.summary.text: Count every component this policy would delete from the selected repository and the space its files take up. This can take a while on a large repository.
cleanup.summary.failed: The totals could not be calculated.
cleanup.summary.nothing: Nothing to delete: no component in {repository} matches the criteria.
cleanup.summary.result: If it ran now, this policy would delete from {repository}:
cleanup.summary.atLeast: If it ran now, this policy would delete at least the following from {repository}:
cleanup.summary.incomplete: The calculation stopped at its time limit, so the policy may delete more than this.
